name: Macachor Meaning Theory
description: A structural framework proposing that meaning is recoverable from invariant structure through progressive compression toward an irreducible substrate.

about.name: Substrate
about.description: The underlying domain from which structural information is derived.

about.name: Structural Compression
about.description: Reduction of representation toward minimum sufficient structure.

about.name: Invariant
about.description: Structure that remains recoverable under admissible transformations.

about.name: Irreducible Meaning
about.description: Meaning identified with the minimum sufficient structure remaining after compression.

about.name: Coherent Resonance
about.description: A proposed state of structural correspondence within the substrate.
